In addition, a slime possesses two eyes and a red core. This core functions similar to a brain and without it the slime is nothing but a pile of ooze. Slimes can regenerate from physical or magical attacks. They can also absorb water to speed up regeneration. However too much water will cause their body to dissolve, leaving their core vulnerable. In an emergency, they can concentrate their slime, forming an Endospore. In their Endospore state, a slime is nearly invincible. However, they cannot move. Slimes can also use their slime to absorb thoughts of others. By pressing their slime against someone's head, they can detect thoughts. They also dislike salt, as salt can dehydrate them.

Their blue, half-transparent bodies are flexible, and can change into various forms. They are intelligent enough to speak, but their thoughts are simple

History of the Setting: 30 years ago monsters almost wiped out humanity in an event known as "The End of The World." Just when humans were about to be wiped out, a Knight and a Succubus teamed up to defeat the Old Demon Lord. There they defeated him, and the succubus became the new Demon Lord. Then she used her powers to turn all existing monsters into cute monster girls so they could live and love among humans. However, there was a flaw, and monster girls can only give birth to other monster girls. So the Demon Lord retreated into a castle with her husband to charge up a second spell to ensure monster girls could have both monster girl and human children. The Order of the Chief Goddess still thinks monsters are evil.
